clearedSpotChecks.check: Lead L-1197: what a caller sees when a callee exceeds a Rex4 per-frame budget on MegaETH (4326), and whether Currency.transfer could read a budget stop as a transfer that returned nothing.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Rerun independently on https://mainnet.megaeth.com/rpc (web3_clientVersion mega-reth/v2.3.1-4499c42@mnet-ash-rpc-2) with eth_call and state overrides, adding the part the research did not test: whether a budget-stopped frame keeps its writes. A child that first SSTOREs slot 0 and then loops without end (compute budget) or writes new slots without end (state growth budget) returned success 0 to its parent, and a second call to the same child returned sload(0) = 0, so the slot write was rolled back. A control child that writes and stops returned success 1 and sload(0) = 1. A budget stop therefore behaves as a revert with data: the success flag is 0, state is undone, and Currency.transfer (src/types/Currency.sol:64-74) requires success before the return data check, then reverts through CustomRevert.bubbleUpAndRevertWith (src/types/Currency.sol:82-86). No partial PoolManager state survives a budget stop of a frame below it.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Rerun of the general and targeted opcode batteries on rpc.monad.xyz (Monad/0.16.7) and mainnet.megaeth.com (mega-reth/v2.3.1-4499c42): every vector returns the specified word.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Ran 16 own edge vectors in one eth_call with code override on https://rpc.monad.xyz, https://rpc-mainnet.monadinfra.com (both answer Monad/0.16.7) and https://mainnet.megaeth.com/rpc: MULMOD with max operands and a 2^256-3 modulus and with mixed limb widths, ADDMOD with overflowing sums, SDIV of -1 by -2^255, SMOD of -7 by 3, DIV across limbs, SIGNEXTEND at index 15, SAR by 255 and 64 of negative values, SHR by 192, SHL by 255, BYTE 15, EXP 3^255, SLT and SGT at the sign boundary. All three endpoints returned the Python reference for every vector (one first mismatch was my own operand order for SLT, identical on all endpoints and correct per the specification). This agrees with the cleared item. It covers the interpreter behind eth_call only, as the research says; the Monad native compiled path is covered by the mined swap replays, not by this check.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Lead L-1137: the Monad main branch EIP-8024 decoding of DUPN, SWAPN and EXCHANGE cannot hide or create a JUMPDEST relative to the interpreter scan, and the PoolManager is not affected.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/category-labs/monad/main/category/vm/evm/opcodes.hpp: eip8024_single_disallowed is 90 < x < 128 and eip8024_pair_disallowed is 81 < x < 128 (lines 631-639), so an allowed immediate is never 0x5B (91) or 0x60 to 0x7F, and consuming one cannot hide a JUMPDEST or shift push alignment. Fetched monad_mainnet.cpp on main: the newest revision is MONAD_TEN from timestamp 1788359400, so no EIP-8024 revision is scheduled on mainnet. eth_getCode of the PoolManager on rpc.monad.xyz and mainnet.megaeth.com returned 24,009 bytes each with no 0xE6, 0xE7, 0xE8, 0x1E or 0x4B byte outside push data and 610 JUMPDEST bytes outside push data, matching the research.
